'''Father Iwanicki''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Graveyard]] or, when combining [[Miskatonic Horror]] with [[Innsmouth Horror]], at the [[Esoteric Order of Dagon]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Horror check|Horror]]

You cannot be [[curse]]d.
